ow: The collarette is an iris ridge, not this membrane.

q: Which term describes age-related loss of accommodation due to lens nuclear hardening?
w: Presbyopia: Greek presbys — old man + ops — eye. Age-related loss of accommodation due to lens nuclear hardening
k: Presbyopia = Age-related loss of accommodation due to lens nuclear hardening
decode: Age-related loss of accommodation from lens nucleus hardening is PRESBYOPIA. The others are lens/vitreous structures.
ow: The vitreous is the gel, not the accommodation loss.

Muscae volitantes are floaters, not the accommodation loss.

q: Which term describes the smooth acellular envelope surrounding the entire lens?
w: Capsule: Latin capsula — small container. The smooth acellular envelope surrounding the entire lens
k: Capsule = The smooth acellular envelope surrounding the entire lens
decode: The smooth acellular envelope around the whole lens is the CAPSULE (a basement membrane). The others are conditions or the vitreous.

Muscae volitantes are floaters, not the envelope.
Presbyopia is an accommodation loss, not the envelope.
The vitreous is the gel, not the lens envelope.

q: Which term describes the clear gel filling the posterior 4/5 of the eyeball?
w: Vitreous: Latin vitreus — glassy. The clear gel filling the posterior 4/5 of the eyeball
k: Vitreous = The clear gel filling the posterior 4/5 of the eyeball
